描述_EN: (restitution of the tunic proposed by roberta cortopassi (cf. bibliography). square of polychrome tapestry, of which only the upper part remains. framing border decorated with alternating stylized acanthus leaf scrolls in the center of each side and a human and bird bust in the corners. the decoration features a Bachian figure in a medallion set in a square in the center of the upper part of the body. belongs to the same tunic as 43.15.8, 9, 10, 14, 15, 16, 17 and 20.
描述_ZN: (归还罗伯塔-科托帕西提议的外衣（参见。 bibliography）。 方形的多色挂毯，只剩下上面的部分。 框架边框，每边中央都有交替的卷轴造型的刺桐叶，边角处有人物半身像和鸟。 纹饰包括一个镶嵌在身体上部中央的正方形中的巴卡纳人像。 与43.15.8、9、10、14、15、16、17、20属于同一件外衣。
时期: 埃及 拜占庭统治时期
